title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Billing the Technician Labor of a Closed Demand Call
content:
## The charge this covers

Once a demand service call has been closed under a rate program held on the Demand Service Rate Programs, the technician labor worked on it stands to be put on the owner's account as an invoiced labor
line against that rate program. One labor line is raised for one closed call. The labor line is raised
without a due day, and it is dated for payment when the billing month's invoice is issued.

## The effect on the account

A new demand service charge entry of the labor kind is opened on the rate program, carrying the work
order the labor was worked under, the money amount billed for that labor and the billing month it falls
in. From that moment the owner owes that amount on the demand service account and can see the labor line
on the work order.

## Raising the line

The desk handles this itself. The tool `charge_demand_labor_invoice_877d69f1` is unlocked and then
called by the agent; the money amount is worked out by the desk from the published terms and the records
and passed in, the tool neither pricing the labor nor judging whether the terms allow the line.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `program_id` | The reference number of the demand service rate program the labor is billed under, read from the rate program lookup on the account. |
| `work_order_ref` | The work order number the labor was worked under, written as WO- followed by 7 digits, exactly as it stands on the call record in the demand service history. |
| `labor_charge_usd` | The money amount billed for the technician labor on that work order, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent and never negative. |

## The receipt

The call returns one line of plain text carrying the reference number of the new demand service charge
entry, the work order number the labor line was raised against, and the amount in USD to 2 decimal
places now standing on the owner's demand service account. A line naming the charge entry reference is
the receipt that the labor line was booked.
